completeness.why: copyPreviousMonth calls shouldFillCategory(prevBudget, 'skip') on its own rows, setZero and the three averages take their categories from getMonthFillCategories with an explicit hidden mode (the hidden filter moved out of their SQL), the income rule lives only in shouldFillCategory, and both sign inversions go through averageToBudgetAmount; the remaining per-site variation is the named mode argument.

interface.why: One selection function with a single hiddenMode parameter whose three named values ('include', 'skip', 'skip-unless-visible') make the preserved setZero and missing-group inconsistencies explicit, plus a small sign helper, with no speculative options.

disguised_duplication.where: The income, hidden and sign rules are removed from every action and live once in shouldFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories/averageToBudgetAmount; no reshaped copy remains.
